Broadcom (AVGO) vs Apple (AAPL): on the same formula, their operating margins are 6.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
